limitations: Does not prove current deployment of this Neuron sample.
Not inferred from the MITRE page modification date.

detection_coverage.notes: The -install branch and Windows artifacts confirm service persistence.
Legitimate-looking Exchange service identity; the name alone is not sufficient.
cmd.exe /c with redirected stdout/stderr exists in code; no attacker command ran.
Different Registry activities served persistence, event-source, ZoneMap, and configuration purposes.
Recursive HKCU\SOFTWARE search and value reads are present in code.
The wildcard HTTPS prefix is local listener configuration, not a remote C2 destination.
RC4-style processing supports encrypted command and response data.
Embedded 1024-bit RSA public key, exponent 65537, OAEP; no private key recovered.
Base64 request, response, and file-content processing is present.
Base64 and RC4-style decoding transform protected input before processing.
Remote protocol file read/write capability exists, but transfer was not exercised.

evidence_limitations: Static capability does not prove execution.
No attacker request or external C2 session was observed.
No external C2 IP address or domain was identified.
No private RSA key was recovered.
The malware-run Procmon PML was unusable.
Group-level reporting does not prove sample behavior.
Kazuar, ApolloShadow, STOCKSTAY, and LightNeuron are not treated as this sample.
